archetypes.name: dyn-fd-safety
archetypes.rationale: Review fd-relative activation and append paths for symlink and TOCTOU escapes.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new progress_file.py fd-anchored helpers, activate_run, and append_breadcrumb_for_run. Focus on whether path validation, O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd use, and temp cleanup fail closed under symlink swaps or malformed run IDs. Check that default flat append behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
